scheme_name: Deen Dayal Upadhyay Grameen Kaushalya Yojana
other_conditions: Must belong to poor households identified through Participatory Identification of Poor (PIP) or be listed in the Below Poverty Line (BPL) households
Youth from MGNREGA worker households with at least 15 days of work in the previous financial year are eligible
Youth from a household with an RSBY card where the youth’s details are mentioned
Youth from households issued Antyodaya Anna Yojana or BPL PDS cards
Youth from a household where a family member is a member of an SHG under NRLM
Youth from a household covered under auto‑inclusion parameters as per SECC 2011
Women, PVTGs, Persons with Disabilities, Transgender and other special groups have an upper age limit of 45 years (general age limit is 15‑35 years)
benefits_summary: Provides skill training and placement assistance to rural poor youth, along with post‑placement support and incentives for higher‑pay jobs.
